description: Whitehead growth-exponent p extension to N=14 — tests whether the refined-VC exponent is the knot 3/2 or a distinct 2-cusp-link value. Gates the exact-prefactor / factor determination.
precision: mpmath dps=60 exact-root, fast O(N^8); N=14 recovered from run log (write() crashed on a numpy object-dtype bug, since fixed)
figure_eight_calibration: same p-free method on the KNOWN-3/2 figure-eight recovers p in [1.45,1.62] (N=8-14 -> 1.538), converging to 3/2; the Whitehead scatters 0.66-1.60 over the same windows
finding: 2-cusp Whitehead growth exponent does NOT convergently pin to 3/2 at N<=14: p-free fit is unstable (0.66-1.60) and inconsistent with the figure-eight clean ~1.5 recovery. The factor-2 result is CONTINGENT on the p=3/2 assumption; whether the 2-cusp link shares the knot 3/2 exponent (or carries a distinct power / extra log term) is OPEN and needs the correct 2-cusp refined-VC asymptotic form (or N>=18).
factor_status: factor 2 holds under p=3/2 (c0=-0.53); p=3/2 itself unverified for the link
